why_this_slot.text: Best modeled placement for Ceddanne Rafaela is slot #8 (4.549 expected team runs/game).
Slots #8, #7, #9, #6, #5, #3, #4 are within 0.01 runs/game of each other — essentially equivalent under the model’s operational band.
Primary actual slot #2 ranks 8 of 9; estimated placement opportunity vs best is +0.012 R/G.
Slot #8 yields 3.93 expected PA/game vs 4.58 at primary slot #2. Batting order changes both game states and plate appearances.
Offensive profile group: Spray Contact (exploratory unsupervised cluster — not a definitive archetype).
Cleanup (#4) models -0.003 R/G vs his average placement — typically less value than mid/lower-order spots when power/run-production profiles are modest relative to the nine.
